notes.title: Check out Umichan Two Scoops!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247550/Umichan_Two_Scoops/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247550/Umichan_Two_Scoops/[/url]

If you had fun with Umichan Sorani please consider checking out Umichan Two Scoops. A game that plays similarly to Umichan Sorani through the perspective of Maiko.

Maiko and Pattie in a bind, their boss asked them to sell ice cream for cash at the beach but the boys are more interested in their hot bodies than cold deserts. It's your choice of what to sell to get the money they need!

For anyone planning to get the game, it's important that any game can try to get 10+ reviews asap to do well in the steam algorithm over the long run.

I can't offer you anything to leave a review if you decide to leave one for Umichan Two Scoops, since it's against steam's policy. This is just intended to be an educational statement on the importance of reviews!

notes.title: Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Names were given to in-game icons to more understand what they do.
[*] POV Scrolling is now locked by default from the beginning and can be toggled on or off via the in game phone menu.
[*] A preview of the combination for the Cafe mini-game is now displayed at the beginning so it can be a memory game instead of a guessing game.
[*] A magnifying glass hint tool was added to the upper left hand corner for the Cafe mini-game
[*] How much money you have is now also numerically displayed on the icon in the game phone menu
[/list]

if you for some reason have a brief Profile error occurred popup before the game starts.
please delete "UmichanSoraniULE" from your "C:\Users\[your username]\AppData\Local" folder and re-run the game.
